worlds.name: Ossara
worlds.description: The green Reach, and the one everybody starts in. Ilvaro's country: worked land, short roads, and a gate in the middle of town that has not opened in living memory.

zones.name: Gatetown
zones.description: The town around the oldest known gate. Everything a person needs on their first day and most of what they need on their hundredth, arranged around a ring of dark stone nobody can make work.

rooms.title: The Gate Road
rooms.description:
The road south out of the yard, wide enough for two carts and rutted like it has carried them. Drainage ditches on both sides, dug straight, cleared every spring.

The last houses give out here and the terraces start showing green over the rise ahead.

rooms.title: Ilvaro's House
rooms.description:
One long room with a plank floor and too many benches, built for a congregation twice this size and used for weddings, inquests, and the storage of a very large cooking pot.

Ilvaro is carved over the door with his arms full of things he is dropping. The carving is not very good. It is beloved, and every proposal to replace it has been voted down.

rooms.title: Khaldra's Hearth
rooms.description:
The inn, the bakehouse, and the place the town holds its arguments, in that order of importance and reverse order of volume. The fire in the long wall has not been out in nineteen years.

There are two ovens. One is for bread and one is for everything else, and mixing them up is the sort of mistake people still bring up years later.

rooms.title: Market Row
rooms.description:
Six stalls under a shared awning that leaks in one particular place everyone has learned to stand clear of. Wick's yard is at the west end and the weaponwright's shed is behind, down the short lane south.

Prices are chalked on a board and revised about as often as the weather changes, which here is twice a day.

rooms.title: North Lane
rooms.description:
A packed-dirt lane running north out of the common, wide enough for one cart and used by two. Houses on both sides, each with a strip of garden and an opinion about the strip next door.

The ground rises towards the north end, where the town stops at a wall about waist high.

rooms.title: The Terrace Gate
rooms.description:
Not a gate in any defensive sense — two posts, a lintel, and a bell on a bracket that is rung when somebody comes back hurt. It marks where the town's responsibility stops and the farms' begins.

Beyond it the land steps down in long green shelves, each one walled in dry stone, all the way to the haze.

rooms.title: The Armourer's Shop
rooms.description:
Hides on frames, a long cutting bench, and the smell of oil and boiled leather. Finished pieces hang along the back wall in size order.

A ledger sits open on the bench listing every jerkin sold in the last four years and who is due an alteration. Three names have been crossed out with a note beside them that says only 'no longer needs it'.

rooms.title: The Bank Path
rooms.description:
Duckboards laid end to end along the bank, from the ferry landing down to the back of Wick's yard. They flex when you walk on them and have been flexing for years.

Every fourth or fifth board is paler than the rest. Someone replaces them as they go soft, one at a time, without being asked and without any system anyone has worked out.

A handcart stands tipped on its end against the bank, well clear of the boards. It is Wick's. Everyone knows it is Wick's, so it stays where it is.

rooms.title: The Cart Turn
rooms.description:
A widening at the top of the gate road, beaten flat and kept clear, where a loaded cart can come about without unhitching the team. The ruts here curve one way only.

A stone post stands at the outside of the turn, scarred down one whole side and unmarked on the other three. It is not a boundary stone. It is what the carts hit.

The provisioner's stall backs onto the turn with its counter to the road. Drivers buy from the seat without getting down.

rooms.title: The Common
rooms.description:
Grass, mostly, kept short by geese that belong to four separate households and recognise none of them. A well stands at the middle under a slate cap.

Ilvaro's house is west, low and whitewashed. Khaldra's Hearth is east and you can find it by the smell of bread at any hour, including the ones when nobody should be baking.

rooms.title: The Gate Yard
rooms.description:
The gate stands where it has always stood: a ring of dark stone twice the height of a man, set into the cobbles with no foundation and no seam. Nothing moves in it. Nobody living has seen anything move in it.

Gatetown grew up around it anyway and treats it the way a town treats a large rock. Crates lean against the near side, children are told not to climb it, and the stone is worn shiny at shoulder height by three generations of people touching it on their way past.

Yrriska's shrine sits at its foot — a bowl of coins, a knot of ribbon, and somebody's dice. It is the only untidy thing in the yard, and the sweepers go around it.

rooms.title: Wick's Yard
rooms.description:
Less a shop than a roofed yard with a counter across the front of it, stacked to head height with crates, coils, sacks, and at least one thing that is definitely a boat.

There is no order to any of it that a customer can see. There is an order to it.

rooms.title: The Low Wall
rooms.description:
The wall is waist high, dry-laid, and has never stopped anything. It is where the town ends because somebody once decided the town should end somewhere, and the ground past it slopes down through gorse for about two hundred feet.

Then it stops. Not a cliff — a cliff has a bottom. The turf ends in a clean line, roots and soil and all, and there is nothing under it.

People picnic here. There are cut marks on the wall's flat stones from generations of people sitting and swinging their heels against it.

Far out past the edge, on a clear afternoon, there are shapes in the distance that could be land. They never resolve, however long you look, and the haze between never quite behaves like haze.

rooms.title: The Mustering Yard
rooms.description:
A square of beaten earth behind the lane, fenced on three sides, with a rack of practice staves and a straw man on a post who has been repaired so often he is now entirely repairs.

The town has no soldiers. It has about forty people who can hold a line for as long as it takes everyone else to get behind the wall, and this is where they find that out.

rooms.title: The Provisioner's Stall
rooms.description:
The last stall before the road out, which is not an accident. Sacks of meal, strings of onions, hard cheese under a cloth, and bandage rolled by the dozen.

A slate by the scale reads: TWO DAYS OUT — THREE DAYS FOOD. It has been rewritten so many times the slate is going soft.

rooms.title: The Rope Ferry
rooms.description:
A flat raft on a hemp line strung bank to bank, with a stool on it that is nailed down. The far bank is close enough to shout across and everybody does.

The rope is spliced in eleven places and each splice is dated in tar. The most recent is from this spring.

rooms.title: The Water Steps
rooms.description:
Eleven stone steps down to a cut in the bank where the river runs slow and brown. Two women are beating laundry against the flat rock and have not looked up.

Buckets go up these steps all day. The steps are worn into shallow bowls and somebody has scratched a tally into the wall that stopped counting at four hundred.

rooms.title: The Weaponwright's Shed
rooms.description:
A forge, an anvil, a slack tub, and a wall of tools hung on painted outlines so a missing one is obvious. Two of the outlines are empty and have been for a while.

The blades for sale are laid on a cloth rather than hung up, which the smith will tell you is because they are for working with and not for looking at.

itemTemplates.name: a roll of clean bandage
itemTemplates.description: Boiled linen, rolled tight, tied with a scrap of the same. Sold by the roll because nobody needs half of one.

itemTemplates.name: a loaf of dark bread
itemTemplates.description: Heavy, close-grained, and baked at Khaldra's Hearth like everything else in this town. Keeps four days and admits it.

itemTemplates.name: a brass knuckle
itemTemplates.description: Four finger-holes cast in a single piece, worn smooth on the inside and not on the outside. Berrin keeps a box of them under the counter and does not display them, which is its own kind of recommendation. It is not a weapon you win a fight with; it is a weapon you have in the hand that is not holding one.

itemTemplates.name: an empty cup
itemTemplates.description: The same thick brown clay, cool now, with a ring of barley stuck to the bottom where the last of it dried. It is Khaldra's crockery, and Khaldra's crockery goes back.

itemTemplates.name: a hand axe
itemTemplates.description: A wood axe with the handle cut down. Half the town owns one for the wood and has never thought of it as anything else.

itemTemplates.name: a filled cup
itemTemplates.description: Thick brown clay with a handle on either side, filled to a thumb's width from the rim. What is in it is mostly barley and is definitely not tea.

itemTemplates.name: a boiled leather cap
itemTemplates.description: Moulded to a head that was not yours and stubborn about it for the first week.

itemTemplates.name: a pair of working gloves
itemTemplates.description: Cut for holding things rather than for hitting them, which turns out to matter less than you would think.

itemTemplates.name: a studded leather jerkin
itemTemplates.description: Ox hide over a linen backing, studded across the chest and shoulders. Tessa makes them in four sizes and alters them free for a year.

itemTemplates.name: a pair of leather leggings
itemTemplates.description: Split hide laced up the outside of each leg, so they go on over boots. Everyone works out why eventually.

itemTemplates.name: a gate-shrine token
itemTemplates.description: A pierced copper disc from the bowl at Yrriska's shrine, worn smooth on one face. Taking one is fine. Taking one without leaving something is the part people have opinions about.

itemTemplates.name: a banded plank shield
itemTemplates.description: Four boards, a strap, and an iron rim. It is exactly as good as it looks and has saved more Ossarans than the wall has.

itemTemplates.name: a short blade
itemTemplates.description: A foot of straight steel with a wrapped grip, made for people who have never owned a sword and may not own this one for long. Berrin sharpens it before it leaves the shop.

itemTemplates.name: a pair of hobnailed boots
itemTemplates.description: Nailed soles, ankle high, resoleable twice. The armourer will point that out unprompted.

itemTemplates.name: an ash walking staff
itemTemplates.description: Shoulder height, banded at both ends, worn pale where a hand goes. Sold as a walking staff. Bought, mostly, as the other thing.

itemTemplates.name: a coil of hemp rope
itemTemplates.description: Twenty feet, laid three-strand, with the ends whipped properly. Whoever made this was not in a hurry.

itemTemplates.name: a pitch torch
itemTemplates.description: A hand's length of ash wrapped in pitch-soaked rag. Takes a hand to carry and smells like it the whole time.

itemTemplates.name: a stitched waterskin
itemTemplates.description: Goat hide, double-stitched, with a wooden stopper on a cord so you cannot lose it. You will lose it.

mobTemplates.name: Tessa Roke, armourer
mobTemplates.description: She works with a strip of chalk behind one ear and measures people without asking. Her jerkins are altered free for a year and she keeps the book that proves it.

emotes.text: chalks a line down a hide and steps back to look at it
says, 'Shoulders first. Everything else you can survive.'

mobTemplates.name: Old Ossa
mobTemplates.description: Nobody agrees whether the Reach is named after him or he is named after it, and he has stopped correcting either version. He runs the rope-ferry when he feels like walking, which is most days.

emotes.text: hauls the rope two arm-lengths, decides that is enough for now, and sits
says, 'It goes when I go. That is the timetable.'

greeting: 'You want across? Then you want me standing up. Give me a moment.'
'Ossa is the river and Ossa is me. Pick whichever one gets you over. Ask about the <rope> if you doubt it.'

topics.text: 'Spliced in eleven places and each splice dated in tar. The newest is this spring. The oldest is older than the deacon. It has never once let go, which is more than I can say for the deacon.'
'Slow and brown and close enough to shout across, which everybody does. It does not go anywhere in particular. Neither do I. We get on.'

mobTemplates.name: Wick, who sells everything
mobTemplates.description: A broad, cheerful man surrounded by more stock than his stall can hold, most of it stacked in an order only he understands. He can find any of it in about four seconds.

emotes.text: pulls something out of a crate without looking and puts it back
says, 'Rope. Everyone comes back for rope.'

mobTemplates.name: Deacon Pell of Ilvaro's house
mobTemplates.description: Young, enormously enthusiastic, and about three years short of knowing what he is doing. He is the fourth deacon in six years and the first who seems to be enjoying it.

emotes.text: looks something up, does not find it, and moves on undismayed
says, 'Ilvaro does not mind if you get it wrong. That is rather the whole thing.'

greeting: 'Ilvaro's house. Weddings, inquests, and the big pot. Ask me about the <markers> if you are going out that way.'

topics.text: 'Open-handed, faintly ridiculous, and genuinely beloved. His festivals involve too much food. I am the fourth deacon in six years, which tells you how demanding the post is and how badly I wanted it.'

'Shaped stones every thirty paces, out to the rim, each cut with a mark that is not any letter we use. Nobody here cut them. Nobody here knows who did. Half of them are down, which is where you come in.'
'Adda. Thirty years at the blank stone and not gloomy about it. She had the order of things right before I did. She usually does. Take what you find out there to her, not to me.'

mobTemplates.name: Corun, who keeps the fire
mobTemplates.description: He tends Khaldra's hearth, which in practice means he has not let it go out in nineteen years and will tell you the number without being asked.

emotes.text: turns a log with the tongs and sets it back exactly where it was
fills a cup for somebody who did not ask and will not pay

greeting: 'Sit where you like. The near side is warmer and everyone chooses the far.'
'Nineteen years I have kept this <fire> in. Ask me in twenty and it will be twenty.'

topics.text: 'Khaldra's. Kept, not lit - lighting a fire is easy, keeping one is the job. It has not been out in nineteen years and it will not be out tonight.'
'The Kept Fire. Bread, hearth, a roof that does not leak. Nothing mystical about her and everything necessary. Her clergy are mostly cooks. I am one.'

'A woman took a coal from this fire the first winter I had it. Paid in a knife I still use. She has not aged a day in nineteen years and she has never come back for the coal. If you meet a smith with no forge, that is her.'
'I do not count them. I know where they are, which is a different thing and takes less arithmetic.' He glances at the shelf without meaning to. 'Fourteen. That is not counting. That is looking.'

mobTemplates.name: Maddy Thorn, provisioner
mobTemplates.description: She runs the stall nearest the road out, which she chose on purpose, and she will ask where you are headed before she asks what you want.

emotes.text: asks a passing carter how the terrace road is holding
says, 'Two days out, three days of food. That is the whole trick.'

mobTemplates.name: Hesper, who sweeps around the shrine
mobTemplates.description: A wiry woman of about sixty with a besom and a grievance about pigeons. She sweeps the whole gate yard and stops a foot short of Yrriska's bowl, every time, in a neat little curve.

emotes.text: sweeps a neat curve around the shrine bowl without looking at it
says, 'Touch it if you like. Everyone does.'
eyes the pigeons on the gate ring with open hostility

greeting: 'Mind your feet. I have done that bit.'
'The pigeons are not sacred. I have asked. Twice.'
'Touch the bowl if you like. Everyone does. I sweep round <Yrriska> and that is the whole of my arrangement with her.'

topics.text: 'Untidy, they say. She got across by not minding what she stepped in, and every crossing since has been untidy in her honour. I sweep round the bowl. I do not sweep it. Ask anyone who has tried.'
'They sit on the ring. The ring has not moved in living memory and they have decided that makes it theirs. I asked the deacon whether they were sacred. He looked it up. They are not.'
'The Watch Stone, out past the markers? Older than any of them, and nobody cut it. Somebody keeps the turf clear round it. Not Adda. Ask her who, and watch her not answer.'

mobTemplates.name: Berrin Halt, weaponwright
mobTemplates.description: He was a farrier for twenty years and still shoes horses two mornings a week, which he mentions if you look at the blades too long without buying one.

emotes.text: draws a thumb along an edge and is satisfied
says, 'Buy the staff. You will not, but buy the staff.'

abilities.name: Kick
abilities.description: A boot to the knee. Nothing elegant, and it does not care what you are holding.

abilities.name: Bash
abilities.description: Put your shoulder behind it. Slower, and it lands heavier.

abilities.name: Battle Fury
abilities.description: Anger sharpens the next stretch of a fight.

abilities.name: Sunder
abilities.description: Batter the guard apart. What comes next lands on what is left of it.

abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.description: Say something unforgivable about its mother, at volume.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.description: The flat of the shield, hard, into whatever is nearest to a jaw.

abilities.name: Rally
abilities.description: Find your feet again in the middle of it.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.description: Set yourself. Nothing moves you for a while.

abilities.name: Crushing Blow
abilities.description: One heavy swing, wound up and committed to.

abilities.name: Last Stand
abilities.description: Refuse to fall. The refusal is most of it.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.description: Shield into the ground, once. Everything in the room decides you are the problem.

abilities.name: Bulwark
abilities.description: Everything behind you is behind you.

abilities.name: Ground and Centre
abilities.description: More of you to get through, and less give in any of it.

abilities.name: Reprisal
abilities.description: Answer it, and make sure it noticed who did.

abilities.name: Unbreakable
abilities.description: Decide not to. The fight can disagree for a while.

abilities.name: Sundering Blow
abilities.description: Take the guard apart so that everyone else's work lands on what is left.

abilities.name: Mass Provocation
abilities.description: Say the unforgivable thing to the whole room, and mean every word of it.

abilities.name: The Last Wall
abilities.description: There is a place past which things do not go. You are standing on it.

abilities.name: Bolt
abilities.description: A thrown splinter of raw force.

abilities.name: Arcane Shield
abilities.description: A shell of ordered air, briefly.

abilities.name: Weaken
abilities.description: Unpick the strength out of something.

abilities.name: Amplify
abilities.description: Wind the next few strikes tighter.

abilities.name: Scorch
abilities.description: Heat with intent behind it, and nowhere for the heat to go.

abilities.name: Enfeeble
abilities.description: Take the fight out of it at the root.

abilities.name: Disjunction
abilities.description: Pull something apart along the seams it did not know it had.

abilities.name: Firestorm
abilities.description: Fill the room with fire and let it decide what burns.

abilities.name: Transmutation
abilities.description: Spend the body to feed the mind. It takes a moment, and it is not a trick you have twice.

abilities.name: Cataclysm
abilities.description: The long words. Slow to say, and worth saying.

abilities.name: Conflagration
abilities.description: Set the air going and let it keep going.

abilities.name: Shatter
abilities.description: Find the fault, and put everything into it.

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.description: It picks its own way across the room and is not slow about it.

abilities.name: Unmaking
abilities.description: Take away some of what it is, and it hits like something less.

abilities.name: Pyre
abilities.description: Everything in the room, twice - once now and once for a while afterwards.

abilities.name: Arcane Surge
abilities.description: The window you fire the long words through.

abilities.name: Gravity Well
abilities.description: Nothing in the room is going anywhere, and standing there is costing it.

abilities.name: The Unwriting
abilities.description: Say what a thing is not, at sufficient volume.

abilities.name: Quick Strike
abilities.description: In and out before it turns.

abilities.name: Evasion
abilities.description: Not being where the blow lands.

abilities.name: Fortify
abilities.description: Settle your grip and pick the angle.

abilities.name: Low Kick
abilities.description: Take the leg out from under it. Whatever it was going to do next, it is not going anywhere.

abilities.name: Body Blow
abilities.description: Ribs, and what is behind them. It will be feeling this for a while.

abilities.name: Provoke
abilities.description: A hit where it will be noticed, and a look daring it to do something about it.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.description: The fight has been going a while. You have more left in you than it has.

abilities.name: Heart Strike
abilities.description: One place, once, properly.

abilities.name: Pressure Point
abilities.description: Find the place that runs the rest of it, and close it.

abilities.name: Rupture
abilities.description: Something inside it is now outside the arrangement.

abilities.name: Opening
abilities.description: Cheap, fast, and it makes the next one worse for them.

abilities.name: Flurry
abilities.description: More than it can count, in less time than it has.

abilities.name: Hemorrhage
abilities.description: Cheap to start and expensive to be on the wrong end of.

abilities.name: Execution
abilities.description: The whole fight, arriving at once and slightly early.

abilities.name: Temple Strike
abilities.description: The heel of the hand, where the skull is thinnest. It forgets what it was doing.

abilities.name: A Hundred Hands
abilities.description: None of them would have done it. All of them will.

abilities.name: Collapse
abilities.description: Take the fight out of it and the rest follows on its own.

abilities.name: Mend
abilities.description: Close what is open, on yourself or on someone beside you.

abilities.name: Guidance
abilities.description: Steady a hand that is about to need steadying.

abilities.name: Wither
abilities.description: Set something going that will not stop on its own.

abilities.name: Restore
abilities.description: Put back what the fight has taken so far.

abilities.name: Blessing
abilities.description: Lend the next while a better edge than it earned.

abilities.name: Renewal
abilities.description: Begin again, without stopping.

abilities.name: Sap
abilities.description: Take the strength and do not give it back.

abilities.name: Benediction
abilities.description: Say it over everyone at once, and mean it.

abilities.name: Intercession
abilities.description: Stand between someone and what was coming for them.

abilities.name: Communion
abilities.description: Say it once, for everyone standing with you.

abilities.name: Reproach
abilities.description: A judgement that settles in and stays. It is not shouted; it is simply true.

abilities.name: Fortitude
abilities.description: More of everyone to get through. Set it before you go in.

abilities.name: Staunch
abilities.description: Pressure and a steady hand. No light, no words - just the bleeding stopped.

abilities.name: Aegis
abilities.description: Something between the group and the weather.

abilities.name: Mending Tide
abilities.description: The one that comes in over everyone at once, when Communion was not enough.

abilities.name: The Account
abilities.description: Everything owed, called in at once. You have been keeping it whether you meant to or not.

abilities.name: Sanctuary
abilities.description: Draw the line around all of them at once, and make it hold.

abilities.name: Absolution
abilities.description: Everything, off one person, now.

abilities.name: Consecration
abilities.description: Support that is not mending: the whole group hits like it means it.

abilities.name: The Long Vigil
abilities.description: Close what is open, raise what is left, and stand over all of it.

quests.name: A Cup for the Ferry
quests.summary: Carry a filled cup from Khaldra's hearth down to Old Ossa.
quests.description: Corun fills a cup for the ferryman most days and gets it down to him on about half of them. Neither of them will leave their post, and the cup does not walk.

dialogue.giverOffer: Corun fills a cup without being asked and sets it on the end of the long table. 'That one is Ossa's. He will not leave the rope and I will not leave the fire, so one of us has to be you.' He pushes the <hot cup> an inch closer. 'Walk like it is hot.'
dialogue.turninReady: Ossa takes it in both hands, drinks a third of it standing, then sits down on the nailed stool to do the rest properly. 'He does this,' he says. 'I have told him I can walk up the hill myself.' He does not look like a man about to walk up a hill.
dialogue.giverComplete: 'He got it hot, then. Good. Cold is an insult and he would drink it anyway, which is worse.'
dialogue.giverInProgress: 'Still on the table, is it. It does not improve with standing there.'

quests.name: What Comes Back
quests.summary: Take Old Ossa's empty cup back up to Corun.
quests.description: Ossa is not walking up the hill and the cup is not staying on the raft. Corun keeps track of his crockery, and has kept track of it for nineteen years.

dialogue.giverOffer: Ossa turns the cup over, taps the last of it into the river, and holds out the <empty cup>. 'Back up the hill with that. He counts them.' He settles onto the stool and takes up the rope. 'He will tell you he does not count them.'
dialogue.turninReady: Corun takes the cup, looks into it out of habit, and stands it upside down on the shelf with the others. 'Fourteen,' he says, to nobody in particular. Then he cuts the end off a loaf and puts it in your hand without discussing it.
dialogue.giverComplete: 'It got there. It always gets there. That is not the same as it getting there on its own.'
dialogue.giverInProgress: 'Still holding it? Up the hill. Four turns and not one of them steep.'

configurations.name: Aldenmoor
configurations.description: The original starter world, kept as a sandbox and as the fixture the playtest plans run against. Matches the engine's built-in fallback.

configurations.name: The Reaches
configurations.description: The Reaches as designed in docs/WORLD.md. New characters begin in Gatetown, at the gate that has not opened in living memory.
